title: TanStack AI 1.0 has an official Jev adapter
summary: On 22 October 2026 TanStack AI, the TypeScript AI library, released version 1.0.0, and its official Jev adapter, @tanstack/ai-typesafe, reached 1.0.0 the same day. The adapter had been on npm since 18 September, three days after Jev launched. With it, a TypeScript app calls Jev through TanStack's decide() function and gets typed answers back. TanStack and TypeSafe wrote the sources below; nothing here has been tested by JevHub.

title: Jev 1.14: Can Jev read images? What changed
summary: On 14 October 2026 TypeSafe released Jev 1.14.0, a small improvement on 1.13 that it says helps most with languages other than English. The same post adds three experimental options behind a special setting: image input, a new answer type called box that returns a bounding box, and a context window of up to 262,000 tokens. TypeSafe says these are not ready for production use. The price is unchanged.

title: How Jack & Jill cut screening costs 88% with Jev
summary: On 12 October 2026, TypeSafe published a case study saying the hiring marketplace Jack & Jill replaced Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite with Jev at one pipeline stage and cut the cost of scoring candidates by 88%, with no significant change in quality. Every figure comes from TypeSafe's own post and has not been independently verified.

title: Jev just got three big rivals
summary: Within ten days, three large companies released models built for the same job as Jev: returning typed decisions instead of text. OpenAI shipped a Decisions API in public beta, AWS's Strands Labs open-sourced Strands Decider, and Cloudflare released Clef and Clef-flash. Most speed and accuracy claims so far come from the companies themselves.

title: TypeSafe raises $870M: what it means for Jev
summary: On 9 October 2026, TypeSafe AI announced an $870 million Series A at a $7.5 billion valuation, led by Andreessen Horowitz. It came 24 days after Jev's launch on 15 September. The money, investors and board seat are reported consistently; the adoption figures are the company's own and are not independently verified.
